+## Validation and limits
+
+The audit used a source-wide scan of non-test TypeScript spawn/runCommand calls, child_process/node-pty imports, process writes and renderer/CLI dispatch references, followed by inspection of concrete effect seams. Existing configuration checks, cancellation and output normalization were distinguished from enterprise protection. No provider, shell action, remote host or model request was executed during the audit.
+

The existing later enforcement halt is preserved; runtimeEvidenceValidated remains false. Prettier was applied and checked; Git whitespace/scope checks accompany the local commit. Runtime tests/type checks are not applicable to this documentation-only change; MM-15-12/MINT-01-01 author facade/fixture coverage and MINT-01-02 executes foundation checks. No images were supplied or analyzed. No top-level documentation or release-note change is needed. Automatic push remains prohibited by the playbook.
